question: Does the all-pair unseen role gap persist after padding is corrected, and does independently balanced distractor identity change it?
graph_selection: Previously studied connected 10-node 4-regular graphs, chosen by graph identity before this generator comparison; all are development graphs for this question.
labeling: One shared1 mapping per graph, fixed across both arms; all 45 labeled unordered pairs are evaluated.
shared_change: Fourth message token receives dedicated id 12 in both arms; vocabulary size 13.
comparison: Historical serial/member/position distractor rule versus per-epoch independently shuffled assignment with exact uniform counts within each semantic candidate group.
unavoidable_episode_difference: Distractor identity, and hence its one-hot identity and stochastic motion, can differ across arms. Other scene geometry is generated from matched random seeds but random-number consumption inside scene() depends only on scene generation, not on identity.

evaluation.primary_metric: mean binary role accuracy over all 25 unseen pairs, then average within graph and across graphs

interpretation_gate: Familiar four-choice accuracy at least 0.99 for each model before interpreting unseen transfer.
limitations: development-only; fresh graphs are needed for independent confirmation
one graph labeling per world in this gate
